protocol.affected_subset: computed from deployed-versus-source predictions before target outcomes; never selected from evaluation loss
protocol.claim_scope: synthetic local non-affine source-misspecification stress test

conditions.correct_source_control: fitted source model without deployment distortion
conditions.local_scene_fold: absolute-log fold around hazard 0.12 for scene=busy only
conditions.local_subject_saturation: monotone tanh compression in log risk for subject=cup only
conditions.local_subject_scene_bump: smooth Gaussian log-risk bump for subject=cup and scene=busy only

protocol.inference: paired seed-cluster 20000-resample bootstrap and exact sign test
protocol.noise: deterministic calibration-only event-status flips; clean target test
protocol.pairing: all deployment warps share source training, calibration rows, test rows, event draws, censoring, and optimizer settings
protocol.split: outcome-independent nested calibration and group-disjoint fixed test; typed gates use identity-disjoint discovery and confirmation
protocol.target_mechanism: in-distribution target rows shared by all frozen deployed-source warps
